sentences.text:
The petitioner herein seeks to challenge the award dated 05.09.2017 passed in land acquisition proceedings for Vadodara - Mumbai expressway / Samiyala in Compensation Case No. 20 of 2023 and prays for a writ of Mandamus commanding the respondents to re-compute the compensation qua the lands of the petitioner by applying the market value as per the rate of non-agricultural land for the NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/11176/2023 ORDER DATED: 13/12/2023 undefined area-in-question, in accordance with the provision of Section 26(1) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013,
and further to apply Factor-2 and all other statutory benefits under the Act, 2013 including solatium and statutory interest.

3. It is vehemently argued by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the respondent No. 2 has wrongly applied the rate of agricultural land while computing the market value of the land-in-question.
4. Be that as it may, essentially challenge in the writ petition is to the computation of market value being contrary to the provisions of the Section 3G(7) of the National Highways Act, 1956.

5. The petitioner being aggrieved by the determination of compensation by the competent authority under sub- section (1) of Section 3G was required to approach the Arbitrator by moving a proper application under Section 3G(5) of the National Highways Act, 1956.

6. As the factual inquiry cannot be made within the scope of the jurisdiction under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, to determine the dispute raised by the petitioner herein, we find that appropriate remedy for the petitioner is to file an application for appointment of Arbitrator to NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/11176/2023 ORDER DATED: 13/12/2023 undefined determine the dispute under Section 3G(5) of the National Highways Act, 1956.
7. The present petition is, accordingly, dismissed.
It is clarified that the Arbitrator shall be required to determine the market value strictly in accordance with law without being influenced by any of the observations made hereinabove.

In case the petitioner approaches for appointment of Arbitrator by moving an application within a period of three weeks from today along with the copy of this order,
the said application shall be entertained without raising any objection as to the limitation thereof and the dispute pertaining to the determination of compensation for the land-in-question shall be decided on merits.
